business_summary.text: Kanohar Electricals manufactures high-voltage power transformers up to 500 MVA 400 kV, Scott-connected railway transformers, and executes substation and transmission EPC projects.

call_points.text: Targeting approximately ₹950 Cr revenue in FY27 with EBITDA margins broadly similar to FY26.
Railways envisage 1,000 traction substations requiring ~2,000 Scott transformers worth ~₹20,000 Cr over 5-10 years.
Working capital cycle stands at roughly 120 days, comprised of 120 receivable days and 80 inventory days.
Supply chain planning is viewed as the primary operational risk to maintaining execution timelines.

guidance.statement: Targeting FY27 revenue of approximately ₹950 crores with broadly similar EBITDA margin profile as FY26.
